overview.text: Seattle icon with a revolving restaurant and glass walls for views.

text.text: People say this observation deck offers breathtaking 360-degree views of the city, mountains, and water, and a unique experience with a rotating glass floor. They highlight the friendly staff and the fun, quick elevator ride. They also like the well-stocked gift shop and the option to purchase drinks and snacks.

overview.text: Vibrant and long-running marketplace highlighting fresh produce, meats, seafood and flowers.

text.text: People say this market offers a wide variety of fresh seafood, produce, flowers, and handmade crafts. They highlight the lively atmosphere, the fun of watching the fishmongers throw fish, and the unique shopping experience. They also like the friendly vendors and staff.

overview.text: Variety of wildlife on display, plus a carousel, rainforest exhibit, and bug house.

text.text: People say this zoo offers a wide variety of animals, including gorillas, hippos, lions, and penguins, and features a historic carousel and a dinosaur exhibit. They highlight the spacious enclosures, the beautiful, natural environment with lots of vegetation, and the family-friendly atmosphere. They also like the friendly and knowledgeable staff.

overview.text: Grass-covered urban park sporting views of Seattle (especially at night) as well as Lake Union.

text.text: People say this city park offers stunning views of the Seattle skyline, Lake Union, and the Space Needle, and is a great spot for picnics, kite flying, and watching seaplanes. They highlight the peaceful and fun vibe, especially in the summer, with free DJ sets, yoga classes, and events. They also like the spacious grounds, ample parking, and free entry.

overview.text: Modern venue with sharks, seals, octopuses and otters, plus jellyfish, tide pools and touch tanks.

text.text:
People say this aquarium offers a variety of marine life, including sea otters, seals, and an octopus, and features an underwater dome and touch tanks. They also highlight the friendly and knowledgeable staff, and the family-friendly atmosphere.

Some reviews mention the admission can be expensive.

overview.text: Aerospace museum featuring 170+ aircraft and spacecraft in addition to an Apollo exhibition.

text.text: People say this museum offers a vast collection of aircraft, including the Concorde, Air Force One, and SR-71, as well as interactive exhibits and a flight simulator. They highlight the museum's family-friendly atmosphere, the opportunity to walk through historic planes, and the knowledgeable staff. They also like the membership option, which provides access to multiple visits.

overview.text: Small park atop a hill with a famed view of Seattle's skyline, plus picnic benches.

text.text: People say this city park offers stunning panoramic views of the Seattle skyline, Space Needle, and Mount Rainier, especially at sunset. They highlight the relaxing and chill vibe, and the perfect photo opportunities for capturing postcard-worthy views. They also like the easy access and free admission.

overview.text: Showcasing the work of Dale Chihuly, this venue features glass sculptures, a garden, and a glasshouse.

text.text: People say this art museum features stunning glass sculptures and a beautiful glass garden. They highlight the unique and inspiring experience, and the opportunity to witness live glass blowing demonstrations. They also like the relaxing and colorful atmosphere.

overview.text: Popular seaside park featuring fire pits, barbecues and a sandy beach.

text.text: People say this city park offers a sandy beach, trails, and stunning views of the Puget Sound and Olympic Mountains. They highlight the relaxing and chill vibe, perfect for picnics, walks, and watching the sunset, and the ample parking and free access. They also like the availability of fire pits, volleyball courts, and a dog park.

overview.text: Striking design for a vast chain library with a reading room, computer lab and a book spiral.

text.text: Visitors say this public library offers a wide variety of books, computers, and study spaces, and they praise its stunning, modern architecture. They also highlight the friendly staff and the peaceful atmosphere.

overview.text: Park offering trails, picnic facilities, and a lighthouse, plus scenic views.

text.text: People say this park offers beautiful trails, a beach, and a lighthouse, with stunning views of the Puget Sound, Olympic Mountains, and Mount Rainier. They highlight the peaceful and serene atmosphere, and the opportunity for hiking, picnicking, and enjoying the sunset. They also like the dog-friendly environment and the variety of ecosystems, including forests, plains, and bluffs.

People say this museum offers a variety of exhibits showcasing movie props, musical instruments, and pop culture memorabilia, including a popular Nirvana exhibit. They highlight the interactive exhibits, such as the sound lab where visitors can play instruments, and the fun, engaging atmosphere. They also like the friendly and helpful staff.

overview.text: Huge outdoor space for dogs, featuring riverside trails, climbing walls and soccer fields.

text.text: Visitors say this park offers a spacious off-leash dog park, a velodrome for bike racing, and hosts concerts and events. They also highlight the park's extensive trails, playgrounds, and sports fields, making it a great place for walking, biking, and enjoying the outdoors.

overview.text: Laid-back park, forested peninsula on Lake Washington featuring a perimeter trail, interior trails, beaches and picnic facilities.

text.text: People say this park offers beautiful views of the lake and Mount Rainier, as well as hiking trails, picnic spots, and a beach. They highlight the peaceful and calming atmosphere, and the well-maintained walkways and trails. They also like the free parking and lake access.

People say this airport offers direct flights and is conveniently located. They highlight the efficient, easy, and relaxing experience, as well as the clean and comfortable facilities. They also like the friendly and helpful staff.

overview.text: Global art collections and temporary installations housed in a downtown space with a restaurant.

text.text: Visitors say this art museum offers a diverse collection of modern and historical art, including Asian, African, and Native American art, as well as special exhibits. They also highlight the friendly and helpful staff, and the convenient location in Volunteer Park.

People say this event venue offers a variety of attractions, including the Space Needle, Chihuly Garden and Glass, and the Museum of Pop Culture, as well as festivals, concerts, and a playground. They highlight the beautiful views, relaxing atmosphere, and fun experience, especially during events and festivals. They also like the convenient access via monorail and the availability of food and drink options.

displayName.text: The Gum Wall at Unexpected Productions Improv

overview.text: Alley with an ever-evolving display of chewed gum plastered to the wall.

text.text:
People say this tourist attraction offers a unique experience with colorful, quirky, and interesting art. They also highlight the iconic, historic, and creative atmosphere, and the fun photo opportunities.

Some reviews mention there can be gross gum.

overview.text: Lakefront park featuring playgrounds and water sports facilities.

text.text: People say this city park offers a dog park, beach, swimming area, walking trails, and picnic spots. They highlight the peaceful and quiet vibe, and the beautiful views of the lake and mountains. They also like the large size of the park and the ample parking.
